findings.title: Identity decryption failure silently overwrites the master identity
findings.evidence: Any exception from load_identity is caught and calls forge_identity. crypto/identity.py:75-106 writes a new random seed to the same master_seed.enc with open(..., w).
findings.trigger: Run the sealer with an existing seed encrypted with a different passphrase or a corrupted seed file.
findings.impact: Destroys the previous private identity and silently rotates signing identity instead of rejecting the sealing operation.

findings.title: Timestamp response existence is mislabeled as authenticated RFC3161 evidence
findings.evidence: AUTHENTICATED_RFC3161_TSA is selected solely by tsr_b64 presence. crypto/rfc3161.py:105-117 base64-encodes any HTTP 200 response without parsing status, signature, certificate trust or message imprint.
findings.trigger: TSA returns HTTP 200 with a rejection response, malformed token, or a token for a different imprint.
findings.impact: Saved artifact claims authenticated timestamp evidence without authenticating its timestamp or binding to the root.

findings.title: Binary payload hash is truncated at the first NUL on read
findings.evidence: payload_hash is ctypes.c_char * 16 (line 34); read accesses the structure field as a C string before bytes(...), although write stores arbitrary 16-byte digest data (80-81).
findings.trigger: Write a digest whose first 16 bytes contain 0x00, then call read().
findings.impact: The returned hash is shorter than the stored digest and loses its suffix, breaking digest round trips and comparisons.

findings.title: Two-node quorum failure branch is unreachable
findings.evidence: iter % 50 == 0 is in an else-if following iter % 10 == 0; every multiple of 50 already takes the first branch.
findings.impact: No two-node failure is tested, quorum_poisoned_events stays zero, and the concluding BFT certification lacks the advertised rejection-path coverage.

findings.title: Verifier records unconditional PASS for properties it does not inspect
findings.evidence: verify_four_renunciations records four literal True values without runtime inputs; verify_bayes_axiom4_disintegration records Split Epi as True solely from is_split_epi. print_report uses these rows in ALL AXIOMS SATISFIED — SYSTEM SOUND.
findings.trigger: Invoke the verifier against its built-in fixture or invoke these methods after an implementation violates the described constraints.
findings.impact: Report presents unchecked assertions as verification successes; the script cannot establish the advertised runtime constraints or a deterministic section identity.

hypotheses.description: Cross-process mmap seqlock uses plain ctypes accesses without explicit atomic acquire/release operations. No claim of actual torn reads is made; memory-order correctness and intended consumers require a focused native-memory audit.
